subject: Materials Science
title: Nanoindentation: Probing at the Nanoscale
description: A short lesson to help you apply Nanoindentation: Probing at the Nanoscale.

hook.text: Press a diamond tip into a surface with millinewton force — measuring hardness of a single thin film layer.

buildup.text: Nanoindentation records force and depth continuously — extracting hardness and modulus from one test.

discovery.text: Indents can be shallower than 100 nanometers — testing coatings without reaching the substrate below.

twist.text: At the nanoscale, surface roughness and tip shape dominate — careful calibration is essential.

climax.text: Semiconductor and biomedical coatings are quality-checked by nanoindentation before leaving the factory.

punchline.text: A billionth-of-a-meter indent reveals a material's mechanical soul.

quiz.question: What can nanoindentation measure that macro tests cannot?
options: Properties of individual thin-film layers or coatings
The melting point of the material
